pages.title: Iron
pages.text: A dependable workshop metal. Iron's Reinforced trait is about avoiding wear and making each repair item count.

pages.title: Reinforced
pages.text: Reinforced makes most uses cost no durability. When repair is needed, one matching repair item restores half of the whole durability bar.$(p)$(bold)Wear ignored:$() 75% of uses$(br)$(bold)Repair item:$() Restores 50% of maximum durability

pages.title: Copper
pages.text: Copper rewards equipment that remains in service as it wears. Its Work-Hardened trait moves through stronger brackets as durability falls.

pages.title: Work-Hardened
pages.text: Copper begins at normal strength. As remaining durability falls, mining speed and physical damage switch to the matching bracket. Only one bracket applies; these bonuses do not stack.$(p)$(bold)75% or more remaining:$() Normal$(br)$(bold)50–75%:$() 25% stronger$(br)$(bold)25–50%:$() 50% stronger$(br)$(bold)Below 25%:$() 2× strength

pages.title: Gold
pages.text: Soft but receptive, gold is chosen for what it lets an enchanter do next. Its Gilded trait works with Better Enchanting.

pages.title: Gilded
pages.text: Gilded does not create experience or improve the tool directly. With Better Enchanting, each gold component opens one additional point of enchantment capacity.

pages.title: Netherite
pages.text: Netherite turns a finished piece into something built for the harshest work. Its Nether-Forged trait combines resilience, force, and fireproofing.

pages.title: Nether-Forged
pages.text: Nether-Forged equipment cannot burn.$(p)$(bold)Maximum durability:$() 2× normal$(br)$(bold)Physical base damage:$() 30% higher$(br)$(bold)Eligible tool heads:$() Diamond harvest tier
